title: Meten Holding Group Ltd. Announces Strategic Alliance to Further Develop Digital Currency Related Businesses
主要内容: Meten Holding Group Ltd. (NASDAQ: METX), an omnichannel training company based in China, has announced a strategic alliance with Tokenomics Digital Tech Corporation (TDTC) to further develop its digital currency-related businesses. The agreement, signed on April 18, 2022, involves a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to expand custodian services for mining machines, third-party digital currency services, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A) of digital currency companies. TDTC will provide custodian services at its mining farms for Meten's mining machines, including investment planning, logistics, and maintenance. Both companies plan to collaborate on third-party investment services by establishing new funds or offering investment advice. The minimum investment from each investor is $1 million. The alliance also includes cooperation in the acquisition of high-quality digital currency companies, with TDTC providing financial due diligence and valuation support. Meten aims to become a leading player in the digital currency industry through this partnership. Meten Holding Group Ltd. has announced a strategic alliance aimed at further developing its digital currency-related businesses. The company emphasized its commitment to expanding its presence in the cryptocurrency and blockchain industry. However, the announcement also included a disclaimer regarding forward-looking statements, highlighting various risks that could affect the company's future performance. These risks include the future development of the cryptocurrency and blockchain industry, the ongoing impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the ability to attract students without a significant decrease in course fees. The company also mentioned the importance of maintaining and enhancing its brands, as well as effectively managing the expansion of its school network. The announcement was made on May 11, 2022, and the company does not undertake any obligation to update any forward-looking statements, except as required by law.
